function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

I don’t have real‑time clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  
New York City is in the **Eastern Time Zone**:

| Season | Standard Time | Daylight Saving Time |
|--------|---------------|----------------------|
| Winter | UTC‑5 (EST)   | –                    |
| Summer | –             | UTC‑4 (EDT)          |

If you’re looking for the precise local time, the quickest way is to check your phone, computer, or an online world‑clock service. If you need a rough estimate, you can subtract 5 hours from UTC during standard time or 4 hours during daylight saving time.
